Let \(f\) and \(g\) be odd functions, so:

\[
f(-x) = -f(x), \qquad g(-x) = -g(x)
\]

For their sum \(h(x)=f(x)+g(x)\):

\[
h(-x)=f(-x)+g(-x)=-f(x)-g(x)=-(f(x)+g(x))=-h(x)
\]

So the sum is odd.
